blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Veteran activists, Indigenous peoples’ groups, and students, including those from the University of the Philippines Baguio, gathered at Igorot Park on Monday afternoon (Nov. 16) to protest the Pax Silica initiative anew and condemn the dispersal of a protest caravan and the arrest of its participants in Muntinlupa City a day earlier. But the scheduled visit of United States President Donald Trump on Tuesday, Nov. 17, drew the strongest criticism during the 5 p.m. rally. “Trump the war criminal is not welcome in this country,” activist Joel Capulong said.
